description: Convert explicit, lasting client feedback into a validated client-owned pack rule without changing the universal plugin or immutable Brand Pack artifacts.

pre_conditions.check: The user explicitly requested or confirmed a lasting brand rule

steps.name: Classify feedback
steps.description: Separate a deliverable-only correction from a lasting client rule. Ask once when permanence is ambiguous.

steps.name: Normalize rule
steps.description: Create a stable semantic id, concise English instruction, narrowest applicable surface, severity, English feedback summary, and optional rationale or local evidence.

steps.name: Check overlap
steps.description: Review existing client rules for duplicates, conflicts, or an id that should be updated or superseded.

steps.name: Persist
steps.description: Run the deterministic learn command. Never edit brand.rules.json or plugin files directly.

steps.name: Reload context
steps.description: Run validate and context for the affected surface and confirm that the active rule is returned.

post_conditions.check: Only brand.rules.json changed unless explicit evidence was added under references/feedback/
Brand Pack version and immutable build-manifest hashes did not change
Rules revision changed only for a material rule change
The learned rule is visible in context for each applicable surface
